items.html:
A hard, uncompromising 'into the wind' opening or first change bowler, Wisneski's no-nonsense and hard-nosed approach was been the cornerstone of the Canterbury attack. He made three one-day appearnaces for New Zealand against Australia in 1999-2000 after an impressive tour of England with New Zealand A, but failed to make any impression.
Martin Williamson
